api.agentBody: The askcalls agent holds your keys on your computer, so Claude or any MCP client can search and read your calls there.

where.claudeDesktop: Settings → Developer → Edit Config, or edit <path>claude_desktop_config.json</path>:
where.cursor: In <path>~/.cursor/mcp.json</path> for all projects, or <path>.cursor/mcp.json</path> for one:

api.path: Desktop apps don't always inherit your shell's PATH. If a client can't start the server, replace bunx with its full path from which bunx.
api.remoteBody: For clients that can't run a local process. It has no keys, so it offers only these tools:
api.remoteCli: With Claude Code and a token from above:

tools.inbox_upload: adds a transcript or audio to your inbox
tools.list_recent_calls: ids, days and durations of recent calls
tools.account_status: plan, call count and pending inbox items

api.inbox: Inbox uploads are visible to the AskCalls server in transit. They're encrypted to your key on arrival and added to your calls the next time you unlock.

prov.subtitle: Managed by AskCalls unless you choose otherwise.
prov.testOkTx: Connected. A 3-second sample transcribed in {s} s.
prov.testNotFound: Bucket not found (404). Check the bucket name and region.
prov.testQuota: Managed transcription is used up for this month.
prov.unavailable: This instance has no managed provider for this.
prov.offConfirm: Audio uploads will be disabled. Transcript uploads still work.
prov.needsBaseUrl: Enter the server's base URL (https, or http on localhost).
prov.agentOnly: Works in the desktop agent. In the browser, requests pass through AskCalls without storing your key or audio.

flow.txManaged: Audio passes through AskCalls servers to {provider}, streamed and never stored. {provider} may keep request logs under its standard policy.
flow.txOwn: Audio goes from your device straight to {provider} under your account. AskCalls never sees it.
flow.txOff: Audio uploads are off. Transcript uploads still work.
flow.askManaged: This call's transcript and your question go through AskCalls servers to {provider}. AskCalls doesn't store them.
flow.askOwn: This call's transcript and your question go from your device straight to {provider} under your account. AskCalls doesn't see them.
flow.askOff: Ask about a call is off.
flow.recManaged: Recordings are kept in the AskCalls bucket, unreadable without your keys.
flow.recOwn: Recordings and bucket credentials go from your device to your bucket, not through AskCalls.
flow.recOff: New recordings aren't backed up. Calls keep their transcripts.
